repository.name: WeeWX packages
repository.description: A community catalog of extensions, drivers, and skins for WeeWX.

packages.name: LiveData
packages.description: Publish live WeeWX readings as static JSON through a signed PHP endpoint.

packages.name: Ecowitt HTTP Push
packages.description: Receive HTTP push uploads from Ecowitt gateways and consoles using the Ecowitt or Weather Underground custom-server protocol.

packages.name: Davis RTL-SDR
packages.description: Receive Davis Vantage Pro, Pro2 and Vue wireless observations through RTL-SDR. Requires the separately built rtldavis receiver.

packages.name: NeoWX Material
packages.description: Material-style weather website with interactive charts and live observations.

packages.name: Belchertown
packages.description: Weather website with live observations, interactive charts and forecasts.

packages.name: Tracer / EPEVER
packages.description: Read EPEVER and Tracer MPPT solar charge controllers over RS485 Modbus. Requires pymodbus 3.11 through 3.x and pyserial.

packages.name: Cumulus realtime output
packages.description: Write Cumulus realtime files, optional realmore data and gauge output from WeeWX observations.

packages.name: Cumulus wxnow output
packages.description: Write wxnow.txt with APRS humidity and missing-value handling from WeeWX observations.

packages.name: Graphite uploader
packages.description: Send WeeWX observations with their original timestamps to a Carbon TCP receiver.

packages.name: InfluxDB uploader
packages.description: Upload WeeWX observations to InfluxDB 1 or 2 with verified TLS and bounded archive replay.

packages.name: Meteotemplate uploader
packages.description: Send WeeWX observations and configured optional sensor fields to a Meteotemplate server.

packages.name: OpenWeatherMap uploader
packages.description: Upload WeeWX measurements to the OpenWeatherMap station API over HTTPS.

packages.name: Prometheus Pushgateway uploader
packages.description: Send WeeWX observations in Prometheus text format to a Pushgateway.

packages.name: Twitter uploader
packages.description: Post formatted WeeWX observations through Twython at elapsed intervals or fixed local times.

packages.name: Zabbix sender service
packages.description: Send WeeWX observations through zabbix_sender and provide a Zabbix 7 template for METRICWX inputs.

packages.name: DivumWX
packages.description: Live weather dashboard with charts, forecasts and astronomy pages. Cleaned font package; requires requests and skyfield.

packages.name: Meteostick
packages.description: Read Meteostick weather observations over a serial connection.

packages.name: SDR
packages.description: Read weather sensors through rtl_433. Requires a separately installed rtl_433 executable.

packages.name: Nova SDS011
packages.description: Add SDS011 particulate concentrations through a serial sensor or a local Sensor.Community HTTP endpoint.

packages.name: Ventus W820
packages.description: Read Ventus W820 weather observations over Bluetooth LE. Requires bluepy and a supported Bluetooth adapter.

packages.name: WH23xx
packages.description: Read Fine Offset WH23xx weather stations over USB.

packages.name: Vaisala WXT5x0
packages.description: Read Vaisala WXT5x0 observations over serial or a TCP serial server.

packages.name: WeatherLink Live
packages.description: Poll the WeatherLink Live local HTTP API, including separate ISS and wind transmitters.

packages.name: ObserverIP
packages.description: Read Ambient ObserverIP observations directly or through an intercepted upload file.

packages.description: Write LOOP packets or archive records as CSV, with optional atomic snapshots and decimal precision.

packages.name: JSON reports
packages.description: Render current and historical weather observations as JSON with optional sensor fields.
